title: The guard refuses writes the plan does not name and allows reads

rows.label: cat > src/lifelike/extra.py
rows.message:
This command writes src/lifelike/extra.py from the shell. src/lifelike/extra.py is not in the plan: it is under the governed folder src/, and .aes/target.yaml does not name it. Add it to .aes/target.yaml through `aes plan prepare/validate/accept` first.

The plan does allow these files:
  src/lifelike/__init__.py
  src/lifelike/cli.py
  src/lifelike/patterns.py
  src/lifelike/render.py
  src/lifelike/rule.py
  src/lifelike/step.py
  tests/test_cli.py
  tests/test_patterns.py
  tests/test_render.py
  tests/test_rule.py
  tests/test_step.py

To see what the plan asks for and which files and tests do it, start from the project's wiki: `python -m lockstep.wiki` prints it, each section a question linking down to the requirement, its files and its test.
